create.name: Sherianna Boyle
create.bio:
Sherianna Boyle is a yoga teacher, author and coach whose work centres on processing emotions as a doorway to intuition and spiritual connection. Trained in education and school psychology, she has taught psychology and mindfulness as an adjunct professor for many years, and she also holds certifications in yoga, breathwork, meditation and Reiki. Out of that mix she developed the Cleanse Method, a seven-step practice for meeting feelings in the body rather than thinking them through, which she set out in her book Emotional Detox and several follow-up titles. More recently her writing has turned towards guidance from spirit: Just Ask Spirit describes a practice for clearing emotional static so that messages from guides and the higher self come through more easily.

She teaches mainly online. Twice a week she leads Cleanse Yoga on Zoom, a gentle class combining twists, breathing and self-massage with a ball, and she offers a self-paced certification for yoga teachers who want to bring the method into their own classes. Other offerings include a higher-self masterclass, seasonal online gatherings that pair emotional release with astrology and intention setting, and one-to-one sessions by phone or video. She hosts a weekly podcast with authors and teachers, and leads weekend programmes at Kripalu.

books.title: Just Ask Spirit: Free Your Emotions to Energize Intuition and Discover Purpose
books.author: Sherianna Boyle
books.description: Her most recent book, on asking spirit guides and the higher self for direction. It pairs her emotional-processing steps with practices for noticing and trusting intuitive guidance in daily life.

books.title: Choosing Love: Discover How to Connect to the Universal Power of Love-and Live a Full, Fearless, and Authentic Life!
books.author: Sherianna Boyle
books.description: An earlier book on love as a guiding force in relationships with others and with oneself, with reflections and practices for acting from love rather than fear.

courses.title: Just Ask Spirit: How to Connect and Manifest with Your Guides
courses.description: A weekend at Kripalu in Stockbridge, Massachusetts, on connecting with spirit guides and the higher self and on the spiritual principles behind manifesting. The programme uses somatic movement, breathwork, chanting and journaling, with time to practise receiving messages. Open to beginners and experienced practitioners.

courses.title: Cleanse Yoga Membership
courses.description: Two live 50-minute Zoom classes a week, on Tuesday evenings and Wednesday mornings, mixing gentle yoga, breathing exercises and self-massage with balls and blocks. Members also get a library of recorded meditations and practices.
courses.price: $30 USD per month (or $12 USD per drop-in class)

courses.title: Cleanse Yoga Certification
courses.description: A self-paced training for yoga teachers on weaving the seven steps of the Cleanse Method into their classes. It is accredited by Yoga Alliance for continuing education.

courses.title: How to Connect to Your Higher Self Masterclass
courses.description: A self-guided course of nine lessons on recognising and strengthening contact with the higher self. It includes teachings, meditations, cleansing practices and reflection exercises for everyday use.

courses.title: Private Sessions with Sherianna
courses.description: One-hour coaching sessions by phone or Zoom, for individuals or couples, using her Cleanse Method. Packages of four sessions are also available.
courses.price: $115 USD per session; $150 USD couples; $400 USD for four

free_resources.title: Just Ask Spirit journal prompts and Cleanse meditation
free_resources.description: Free downloads sent by email: a short journal of seven questions for asking your guides and a recorded Cleanse meditation for resetting your inner state.
